report_hash_policy: This report is not included in its own SHA256 map.

admission.policy: Fail fast: at most one active evaluation, zero queued waiters. Contention raises LiveTTSBusy.
admission.locking: Persistent app-owned inode; O_CREAT|O_RDWR|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC, mode 0600, regular file, current uid, single hardlink; LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB; verify path inode after acquisition. Never unlink or replace lock.
admission.lifecycle: Acquire host lock before native task; retain both workload slot and host flock through cancellation-resistant owned-child cleanup/reaping, including repeated caller cancellation.
admission.constructor_injection: SelaLiveTTS(..., coordinator=AdmissionCoordinator(temp_lock, production_probe=synthetic_probe)). All focused backend fixtures inject isolated coordinators.
admission.production_priority: Read-only /proc cmdline/cwd detection before lock, after lock, during evaluation every 0.05 seconds by default, and before returning native output. Probe errors deny/cancel evaluation. Vanished PIDs are ignored; incomplete live snapshots deny.
admission.production_atomicity: Production does not participate in this new flock. Detection/cancel is best-effort, NOT atomic exclusion against unchanged production. Start/snapshot races and between-poll overlap remain possible.
admission.owned_process_only: Only the evaluation native task and its _bounded_process-owned child are cancelled/terminated/reaped. No production signal or coordinator modification.
